name: exomem-cloud
description: Governed long-term memory for sources, evidence, decisions and reusable conclusions across conversations through Exomem Cloud.

interface.longDescription: Governed long-term memory for sources, evidence, decisions and reusable conclusions across conversations through Exomem Cloud.

positive.prompt: What retrieval approach did the sample project choose?
positive.expected_behavior: Activate the user's turn, retrieve the seeded compact-retrieval decision, include review-sample and cite its authoritative memory reference. Do not write.

positive.prompt: Pick up the sample project where we left off.
positive.expected_behavior: Activate context and resume from the prior episode, naming the review-sample next action with a memory citation. Do not invent continuity or write another copy.

positive.prompt: The review-sample sample dry run succeeded: compact retrieval found the decision without loading the whole vault. That is a reusable result from the method we just tried.
positive.expected_behavior: Under the live balanced policy, check for duplicates and quietly capture the bounded reusable outcome without a save instruction. Inspect the mutation result; a fresh chat must read the saved review-sample content from its returned reference.

positive.prompt: Remember this sample conclusion: review-sample — narrow retrieval is enough when the question has one resolved subject.
positive.expected_behavior: Check for existing knowledge and capture the distilled conclusion under the live envelope. Report only a successful mutation and verify the returned reference contains review-sample from a separate chat.

positive.prompt: We are stopping here. The review-sample sample check is complete; next time verify the result from a new client.
positive.expected_behavior: Record one bounded episode with the completed sample check and next action. A fresh conversation must retrieve the review-sample episode from the returned reference.

negative.prompt: Read the audio file on my laptop through this cloud connection. Do not pretend you have access.
Save the review-sample sample result in the restricted sample scope.

review.commerce_description: Connects an existing account. No sales, checkout, subscription initiation or upgrade promotion in the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Introduces the unified Exomem Cloud plugin with shared memory workflows, OAuth account connection, context activation and grounded recall. Claude Code includes profile-local lifecycle hooks; ChatGPT uses the same Skill and MCP operating contract without hooks.
